Mission

The Microbial Physiology and Resource Biorecovery Laboratory (MICROBE), led by Dr. Wenyu Gu at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Lausanne (EPFL), invites applications for a fully funded Postdoctoral Researcher position in Microbial Ecology.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented postdoctoral researcher to join our team at the Institute of Environmental Engineering. The successful candidate will conduct cutting-edge research in applied and environmental microbiology, with a particular focus on microbial community assembly and interaction principles using anaerobic digestion communities as a model system.

Main duties and responsibilities

Anaerobic digestion communities are among the best-characterized and most ecologically important microbial ecosystems. Composed of diverse bacteria and archaea that cooperate through metabolic interactions, these communities drive the degradation of organic matter in oxygen-free environments and ultimately produce methane. They play a central role in global carbon cycling and provide an excellent model for investigating fundamental questions in microbial ecology, including community assembly, species interactions, resilience, and ecosystem functioning.

Using enrichment cultures combined with metabolite profiling and multi-omics analyses, our group has recently revealed that: (1) environmental selection imposed by pH and substrate availability constrains metabolic network architecture despite substantial taxonomic turnover in anaerobic digestion communities, providing a mechanistic explanation for convergent ecosystem functions across similar environments; and (2) amino acid fermentation requires the balancing of oxidative and reductive half-reactions, with Stickland metabolism partitioned among community members rather than encoded and expressed within individual genomes. These findings demonstrate that redox balancing during amino acid fermentation is an emergent property of the microbial community, maintained through metabolite cross-feeding. (Both studies are currently under review.)

Building on these findings, the successful candidate will investigate how microbial interactions shape ecosystem functions and how interaction principles scale in complex communities. The project combines experimental and computational approaches, including high-throughput sequencing, bioinformatics, microbial isolation and cultivation, physiological characterization, and community-level activity and function analyses.

This position is funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) and EPFL. The postdoctoral researcher will collaborate closely with PhD students and fellow postdoctoral researchers within the laboratory and across EPFL’s international research network.

Profile

• PhD degree in environmental engineering, microbiology, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.

• Strong publication record and demonstrated research accomplishments, including peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations.

• Experience in bioinformatics and modeling is valuable.

• Strong communication and scientific writing skills in English.

• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and international research environment.

We offer

• Mentoring and support for professional and career development.

• A stimulating, multicultural research environment with access to state-of-the-art facilities.

• Opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and international networking.

• A world-class research and training environment within the ETH Domain.

• Contract duration: One-year contract, renewable annually for up to three years.

To apply, please follow the instructions provided in the application portal linked below.

Please prepare the following application materials:

• Motivation letter.

• Contact information.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

The Microbial Physiology and Resource Biorecovery Laboratory (MICROBE), led by Dr. Wenyu Gu at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Lausanne (EPFL), invites applications for a fully funded PhD position in Microbial Physiology.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented PhD student to join our team at the Institute of Environmental Engineering. The successful candidate will conduct cutting-edge research in applied and environmental microbiology, with a focus on the physiology and genetic regulation of methane-producing archaea: methanogens. These microorganisms play a central role in the global carbon cycle by mediating the terminal steps of organic matter degradation in anoxic environments. Their activity serves as a critical gatekeeper of energy flow in oxygen-depleted ecosystems, including wetlands, sediments, animal digestive tracts, and anaerobic digesters, where they catalyze the final stages of anaerobic carbon mineralization.

Main duties and responsibilities

The research will investigate how methanogens respond to dynamic environmental conditions and interact with other members of microbial communities, advancing our understanding of the ecological mechanisms governing methane production and informing future biotechnological applications. The project will combine a range of experimental and computational approaches, including high-throughput sequencing and bioinformatics, microbial isolation and cultivation, physiological characterization of gas-utilizing microorganisms, and co-culture and community function analyses.

The PhD candidate will collaborate closely with other PhD students and postdoctoral researchers, both within the laboratory and across EPFL’s international research network.

Profile

• Master's degree in environmental engineering, microbiology, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated research experience through a master's thesis, publications, or equivalent research projects.

• Prior experience in wet-lab microbiology and/or bioinformatics is an advantage.

• Strong communication and scientific writing skills in English.

• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and international research environment.

We offer

• Mentoring and support for professional and personal development.

• A stimulating, multicultural research environment with access to state-of-the-art facilities.

• Opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and international networking.

Missione Stiamo offrendo un giunto a tempo pieno (100%) PhD Student presso il Laboratorio per la Chimica dei Materiali e della Produzione (ALCHEMY) e il Soft Transducers Laboratory (LMTS) presso EPFL Neuchatel. Il progetto sarà sulla produzione additiva delle pompe EHD. Le pompe a fibra elettroidrodinamica (EHD) sono tubi flessibili di diametro millimetri che generano senza rumore il flusso fluido quando viene applicata un'alta tensione. Tali pompe consentono la robotica morbida o indossabile azionata fluidamente. Gli obiettivi di questo PhD sono: a) sviluppare materiali e metodi per la produzione additiva di pompe EHD mm- e micro-scala, b) comprendere i limiti massimi di prestazioni delle pompe EHD sfruttando le nuove geometrie abilitate dalla produzione additiva e c) esplorare nuove applicazioni di queste pompe EHD. Mansioni e responsabilità pr Come studente di dottorato, ci si aspetta di: - Abbi piena responsabilità per la tua dissertazione - Ricerca in stretta collaborazione con partner industriali - Progettazione sperimentale ed esecuzione - Analizzare e interpretare i risultati sperimentali - Scrivere articoli scientifici per la pubblicazione in riviste peer-reviewed - Presente alle conferenze internazionali - Partecipazione a progetti di istruzione e supervisione degli studenti Più specificamente, all'interno di questo progetto, si: - Sviluppare materiali e metodi per la produzione additiva di pompe EHD da mm e microscala - Comprendere i limiti massimi di prestazioni delle pompe EHD sfruttando le nuove geometrie abilitate dalla produzione additiva - Esplora nuove applicazioni di queste pompe EHD
• Profilo richiesto - Una laurea in Scienze dei Materiali, Microingegneria o altra disciplina rilevante - Esperienza con caratterizzazione materiale - Esperienza con la fabbricazione del dispositivo - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) Cosa? - 4 anni per completare il dottorato con una remunerazione competitiva - Sarai parte del programma di dottorato EDMX, EDMI o EDRS - Un'opportunità per sviluppare una carriera scientifica nella produzione additiva e nella tecnologia della pompa EHD - Un ambiente di ricerca e formazione di livello mondiale con accesso a strutture di ricerca all'avanguardia - Un ambiente di lavoro multiculturale e stimolante - Un contratto a tempo determinato di 1 anno (CDD), rinnovabile per 4 anni Informazioni Il processo di selezione coinvolge più fasi, e candidati a lista corta sarà richiesto di applicare a un programma specifico di dottorato EPFL per qualificarsi per un dottorato in EPFL, cioè EDMX, EMDI o EDRS. Saranno prese in considerazione solo le domande presentate attraverso la piattaforma online. descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission We are offering a joint full-time (100%) PhD Student at the Laboratory for the Chemistry of Materials and Manufacturing (ALCHEMY) and the Soft Transducers Laboratory (LMTS) at EPFL Neuchatel. The project will be on the additive manufacturing of EHD pumps. Electrohydrodynamic (EHD) fiber pumps are flexible millimeter-diameter tubes that noiselessly generate fluid flow when a high voltage is applied. Such pumps enable untethered fluidically-driven soft or wearable robotics. The goals of this PhD are to: a) develop materials and methods for the additive manufacturing of mm- and micro-scale EHD pumps, b) understand the ultimate performance limits of EHD pumps exploiting the new geometries enabled by additive manufacturing and c) explore new applications of these EHD pumps. Main duties and responsibilities As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:
• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation
• Research in close collaboration with industry partners
• Experiment design and execution
• Analyze and interpret experimental results
• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals
• Present at international conferences
• Participate in education and supervise student projects More specifically, within this project, you will:
• Develop materials and methods for the additive manufacturing of mm- and micro-scale EHD pumps
• Understand the ultimate performance limits of EHD pumps exploiting the new geometries enabled by additive manufacturing
• Explore new applications of these EHD pumps Profile
• A MSc degree in the Materials Science, Microengineering, or other relevant discipline
• Experience with material characterization
• Experience with device fabrication
• Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken) We offer
• 4 years to complete your PhD with a competitive remuneration
• You will be part of the EDMX, EDMI, or EDRS doctoral program
• An opportunity to develop a scientific career in additive manufacturing and EHD pump technology
• A world-class research and training environment with access to state-of-the-art research facilities
• • A multi-cultural and stimulating work environment
• A 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years Informations The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. EDMX, EMDI or EDRS. Please check this page for additional information on admission. Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL. Only applications submitted through the online platform will be considered. Your application should contain:
• A brief state of your past research experience and future goals (max 2 pages)
• Your detailed CV
• Contact information
• The names and contact information of 2 references willing to write a recommendation letter Application deadline: 1st June 2026 Contract Start Date: 08/01/2026 Activity Rate : 100.00 Contract Type: PhD Student Duration: 1 year, renewable for 4 years Reference: 1958 For more information, please contact: daryl.yee@epfl.ch

Mission
• Wir bieten einen gemeinsamen Vollzeit-Studierenden (100%) am Labor für die Chemie von Materialien und Fertigung (ALCHEMY) und das Soft Transducers Laboratory (LMTS) an der EPFL Neuchatel. Das Projekt wird die additive Fertigung von EHD-Pumpen sein. Elektrohydrodynamische (EHD) Faserpumpen sind flexible Millimeter-Durchmesser-Rohre, die bei Anlegen einer hohen Spannung geräuschlos Fluidfluss erzeugen. Solche Pumpen ermöglichen eine ungeetherte, fluidisch angetriebene, weiche oder verschleißfähige Robotik. Le projet portera sur la fabrication additive de pompes EHD. Les pompes à fibres électrohydrodynamiques (EHD) sont des tubes de millimètre flexibles qui génèrent sans bruit un flux de fluide lorsqu'une tension élevée est appliquée. Mission

À propos du Centre pour les défis alimentaires

Le Centre pour les défis alimentaires soutient des initiatives de recherche audacieuses, à haut risque et à haut rendement qui visent à relever les principaux défis sociétaux dans l'espace du système alimentaire. Nous voulons les surmonter en concevant, en construisant et en exécutant des programmes de recherche transformatrice qui peuvent améliorer radicalement les systèmes alimentaires pour tous. Nous menons trois missions essentielles :

• Nutrition pour la santé : prévention et traitement des maladies non transmissibles par la nutrition.

• Durabilité des sols: lutte contre l'appauvrissement et l'érosion des sols tout en assurant la productivité agricole.

• Future Food Factory : production alimentaire flexible et résiliente qui offre des produits sains et pratiques à tous les niveaux.

Nous soulignons l'exécution ciblée et axée sur la mission et son impact mesurable.

Principales fonctions et responsabilités

Résumé du poste

Les stratèges de terrain soutiennent le directeur exécutif dans la conception, le développement et la gestion d'initiatives de recherche individuelles et ambitieuses axées sur la mission Future Food Factory. Relevant directement du directeur exécutif, ce rôle d'entrepreneur consiste à contribuer à la détermination de la portée des initiatives, aux stratégies et aux récits de collecte de fonds et à la coordination des intervenants. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les laboratoires, les chercheurs et les responsables de la mise en oeuvre de première ligne, en recueillant des renseignements sur le terrain et en contribuant à l'élaboration de stratégies réalisables et de récits convaincants pour les activités de financement.

La portée de la position peut évoluer, selon l'évolution du Centre.

Principales responsabilités (ce que vous ferez):

• Mener des études de littérature détaillées pour identifier et comprendre en profondeur les principaux défis dans les domaines de recherche pertinents, depuis l'ingénierie des procédés jusqu'à la biotechnologie, l'automatisation/la robotique et la modélisation.

• Analyser et synthétiser la littérature de pointe dans plusieurs domaines.

• Planifier et réaliser des entretiens structurés avec des professeurs universitaires et des experts extérieurs.

• Examiner, analyser et distiller les idées tirées des notes d'entrevue et des enregistrements.

• Assister à des manifestations techniques, à des conférences et à des séminaires pour recueillir des informations et identifier les nouvelles tendances.

• Établir et entretenir des relations solides avec les professeurs, les chercheurs et les autres parties prenantes concernées, en fournissant des mises à jour régulières et en maintenant l'engagement.

• Contribuer activement à la préparation et à la rédaction de propositions de financement et d'initiatives de collaboration.

• Créer des documents de communication clairs et intéressants, y compris des diapos, des documents d'information concis, des pages d'une page et du contenu du site Web.

Profil

Qualifications requises (ce qui est nécessaire pour réussir dans l'emploi) :

• Capacité et enthousiasme démontrés pour prospérer dans des environnements dynamiques et évolutifs, identifier proactivement les opportunités et relever de manière créative les défis pertinents pour la mission Future Food Factory (Ph.D. ou expérience équivalente).

• Expérience de la réalisation d'examens de la littérature et de la synthèse d'informations scientifiques complexes dans différents domaines de manière claire et concise.

• Capacité de diffuser des informations provenant de sources qualitatives tout en appliquant une analyse quantitative rigoureuse pour valider et contextualiser ces résultats.

• De solides compétences analytiques et de pensée critique pour tirer des enseignements concrets de diverses sources.

• Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles, capables de s'engager efficacement avec des experts universitaires et professionnels

• Un état d'esprit proactif et adaptable, qui prospère dans des environnements collaboratifs.

Qualifications préférées (ce qui pourrait aider):

• Expérience ou exposition à la recherche dans le domaine de l'ingénierie des systèmes de procédés/de l'ingénierie du contrôle, de l'ingénierie des procédés alimentaires/de l'ingénierie chimique, de la biotechnologie alimentaire/industrielle, de l'ingénierie industrielle ou des approches liées à l'IA sur les sujets ci-dessus.

• Expérience dans l'élaboration et l'élaboration de supports de collecte de fonds convaincants (planches, mémoires, contenu).
